## PRB1.3. Safety

-   In 2025, Croatia Control achieved the planned maturity levels set out in its performance plan for all five components of the EoSM. In more detail, Croatia Control exceeded the planned level in Safety Policy and Objectives.

-   Croatia has not included any airports in their RP4 performance plans, thus not reporting on runway incursions during the reference period.

-   The rate of separation minima infringements (SMIs) at State level was 0.29, and at ANSP level 0.29. Both indicators were below the Union-wide average. When comparing to 2024, the rate of separation minima infringements has decreased at both State level and at ANSP level.
